import createBrowserRouter.description: **Data mode.** Router using the History API.

createBrowserRouter().description:
**Data mode.** The standard router. Pass the tree to `<RouterProvider router={router} />`.
Use `Component`/`ErrorBoundary` (component refs) or `element`/`errorElement` (JSX) — not both for the same slot.

createHashRouter().description: **Data mode.** Stores the location in the URL hash. For static hosts that cannot rewrite all paths to index.html.

createMemoryRouter().description: **Data mode.** Keeps history in memory. The router of choice for tests and non-browser environments.

import createRoutesFromElements.description: **Data mode.** Build a route array from JSX `<Route>` elements.

createRoutesFromElements().description: **Data mode.** Declare Data mode routes as JSX instead of objects. Handy when migrating from a `<Routes>` tree.

import createStaticHandler.description: **Data mode.** Server-side data loading for a custom SSR setup.

createStaticHandler().description:
**Data mode.** Runs loaders/actions on the server for a request, producing the context an SSR render needs.
Only for hand-rolled SSR — Framework mode does this for you.

createStaticRouter().description: **Data mode.** Builds the router that `<StaticRouterProvider>` renders on the server.

import createRoutesStub.description: Test helper that renders components needing router context.

createRoutesStub().description:
Renders a component with real router context, stubbed loaders and actions.
The supported way to test components that call `useLoaderData()`, `<Form>` or the navigation hooks.

import RouterProvider.description:
**Data mode.** Provider for browser apps.
Import it from `react-router/dom` — that build integrates with `flushSync` and view transitions. The one exported from `react-router` targets non-DOM renderers.

RouterProvider.description: **Data mode.** Renders a router created by `createBrowserRouter` and friends. Replaces `<BrowserRouter>`.

Data mode entry.description: **Data mode.** Complete Data mode setup — router definition plus mount. The mode to pick when you want loaders and actions without the Framework build.

import StaticRouterProvider.description: **Data mode.** Server counterpart of `RouterProvider` for SSR.

StaticRouterProvider.description:
**Data mode.** Renders a static router built by `createStaticRouter`, using the context from `createStaticHandler().query()`.
The Data mode SSR pair — Framework mode handles this itself.
